facts.fact: Vital Strategies' brief says Namibia's Ministry of Health and Social Services uses electronic notification to support the recording of births, within an integrated CRVS and identity system.

facts.fact: Vital Strategies' brief says Namibia's electronic notification supports the recording of deaths and causes of death, with electronic birth and death notification part of its integrated system.
facts.system: Namibia integrated CRVS and identity management system
